_meta.purpose: Objective accuracy gate for Smart Judge legal answers (docs/STRATEGY_GAP_2026-10-12.md section 4 item 4 / L1). 70 questions: 50 dev + 20 held_out=true. Each question was written from a real article row of the corpus served as iran_laws_v3.
_meta.corpus: iran_laws_v3 = data/legal/phase1_canonical.jsonl (v2 laws) + data/legal/staged/corpus_fill_2026-10-11*.jsonl + corpus_fill_2026-10-12_ekhtebar.jsonl. Only ekhtebar.ir is used as the legal web source (unofficial tier); the constitution comes from the staged wikisource file.
_meta.status: text_verified = every must_include phrase and the quoted article text were checked mechanically against the staged corpus text (verified_by auto:article_text); needs_lawyer = depends on interpretation, validity or adjustable figures, see needs_lawyer_reason; lawyer_verified (field lawyer_answer, lawyer_answered_at) / lawyer_rejected are set only after the lawyer answers; 2026-10-13 answers applied to items 4, 5, 6 (lg-adm-19 and lg-soc-76 stay needs_lawyer). Review sheet: docs/legal/LAWYER_REVIEW_GATE_FA.md
_meta.run_retrieval: python3 scripts/eval/legal_gate.py retrieval   (no LLM, 0 USD; needs Qdrant + embedder, run on the server)
_meta.run_answer: python3 scripts/eval/legal_gate.py answer --base-url URL --confirm-spend   (calls the live chat endpoint, hard cost cap)

fields.expected_law: exact law_name of the corpus row
fields.expected_articles: article_no values (strings) of that row; a hit on any of them counts
fields.must_include: short exact phrases from the article text; checked after digit/ZWNJ/Arabic-letter normalisation
fields.must_not_include: model-name mentions and unrelated laws that must not appear in an answer
fields.held_out: true = do not tune prompts or retrieval against these; report them separately
fields.law_any/articles: kept for compatibility with scripts/eval_chat_golden.py retrieval_hit

_meta.must_include_caveat: Phrases come from the statute wording. A correct answer may paraphrase (digits for words, different order), so answer-mode failures on must_include are a signal to inspect, not proof of a wrong answer.
